prompts.title: Instagram Flash Restyle
prompts.prompt:
Apply only an Instagram Flash filter-style effect to the uploaded image. Do not regenerate, redesign, crop, reframe, beautify, retouch, or change any content. Preserve the exact same person, face, expression, pose, outfit, hairstyle, objects, background, framing, and composition. Change only the filter treatment: night conversion, direct flash behavior, color grading, visible noise, and film grain.
Convert the image into a darker night-like / low-light version of the same scene. Make the environment cooler, moodier, and richer, with a strong green-cyan / teal ambience and deeper night density, while keeping the original scene recognizable. The background should become darker and cooler than the subject, but not muddy or fully black.
The subject treatment is critical: light the subject with a strong direct on-camera frontal flash that is clearly visible in the result. The flash must dominate the subject more than the ambient light. The face, skin, hair, and clothing facing the camera should look brighter, flatter, more directly flash-lit, and slightly lifted in exposure. The subject should appear more illuminated and more separated from the surroundings, like a real camera-flash snapshot, not a softly relit portrait. Keep the skin warm, bright, glowing, and flash-washed, while the surroundings stay cooler and darker.
If reflective, glossy, metallic, leather, glass, polished, or shiny surfaces are present, show realistic small flash reflections / specular pops where appropriate. If the scene geometry naturally allows it, include a believable subtle hard-edged flash shadow behind the subject or nearby objects, but only where it would occur naturally.
Match the overall look of a rich Instagram Flash-style photo: stronger night mood, cooler green-cyan ambience, brighter flash-lit subject, slightly punchier contrast, and a more obvious filtered look. Add visible digital noise and fine 35mm color-negative film grain across the whole image. Keep the noise and grain clearly visible, especially in darker areas, smooth surfaces, and the background. If the original image already contains noise or compression texture, do not clean it up — blend it naturally into the overall grain structure.
The final result should look like the same original photo captured at night with a strong direct camera flash, featuring richer green-cyan ambience, a much more obviously flash-lit subject, visible film grain, visible noise, and a filtered Instagram Flash look.
Avoid: soft studio lighting, weak flash on the subject, polished portrait lighting, over-clean denoising, overly neutral colors, dull flat skin, muddy blacks, or changing the image content.

prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the primary identity source. The generated portrait must match the same person exactly, preserving precise facial structure, head shape, jawline, cheekbones, eyes, nose, lips, hairstyle, glasses style, skin tone, and overall proportions. Maintain true identity fidelity and strong facial recognition accuracy. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter facial features. Preserve natural asymmetry, skin texture, and authentic likeness.
Create a highly stylized, ultra-detailed futuristic e-sports gaming profile card or “leader card” with a legendary-tier competitive aesthetic. The composition is in vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, centered, symmetrical, and designed like a premium digital character card from a modern competitive video game.
Central Portrait & Pose

The subject is centered in the frame, shown from mid-torso upward, facing forward with direct eye contact. He is making a confident “shushing” gesture, holding his right index finger vertically against his lips, conveying a calm, dominant, and quietly confident persona. His posture is upright and composed, with relaxed shoulders and balanced framing.
He is wearing a professional e-sports athletic jersey in black and electric blue, featuring realistic fabric texture, subtle stitching, breathable mesh panels, and modern competitive gaming uniform styling.
Background & Aura

Behind the subject’s head is a glowing circular digital halo or energy portal in bright neon blue, perfectly centered and symmetrical. The halo emits soft radial light rays and contains subtle sci-fi elements such as faint hexagonal grid patterns, floating digital particles, glowing data fragments, and atmospheric sparkles. The background fades into a deep dark blue and black gradient with depth, cinematic glow, and futuristic ambiance.
Card Frame & Border Design

The entire portrait is enclosed within a thick, metallic, futuristic frame with layered dimensional structure. The frame is made of brushed silver metal with illuminated neon accents in electric blue and subtle gold/yellow highlights. The corners are angular, geometric, and industrial, with glowing seams, reflective metallic edges, and sci-fi panel detailing. Soft light reflections and glow effects enhance the premium, legendary card appearance.
Typography & Branding

At the top center of the card, display the name:
“JACK XP”
in large, bold, futuristic sans-serif typography, white with bright blue neon glow, subtle metallic reflections, and soft bloom lighting.
Directly below it, display the title:
“LEADER”
in smaller, clean teal or cyan futuristic font with subtle glow.
On the subject’s chest area, overlay a shield-shaped crest logo with metallic gold and blue textures. The crest reads:
JACK XP

LEADER

ARMY
with layered typography, glowing accents, beveled metallic edges, and premium emblem styling.
Gaming Statistics Panel

At the bottom of the card, include a sleek futuristic stats panel with glowing borders and dark metallic background. Display the following performance metrics in high-contrast, bold, futuristic font:
HEADSHOT RATE: 97%

K/D RATIO: 5.2

WIN RATE: 93%
The numbers should be large, bright, and glowing in electric blue, with smaller white labels above them.
Lighting & Rendering Style

Use cinematic studio lighting combined with futuristic neon rim lighting. The face must remain clearly visible with realistic skin tone and proper exposure. Add soft blue rim light around the edges of the subject to integrate him naturally into the sci-fi environment. Include subtle glow bloom, volumetric light, and atmospheric depth.
Color Palette

Dominant colors: electric blue, deep navy blue, black, metallic silver

Accent colors: neon cyan, subtle gold/yellow highlights

Maintain high contrast, rich saturation, and premium digital finish.
Rendering Quality

Ultra-realistic, hyper-detailed, 8K resolution, professional e-sports character card, sharp focus, clean edges, cinematic contrast, advanced glow effects, realistic materials, and premium competitive gaming aesthetic.

prompts.title: The Animated Icon
prompts.prompt:
Create an exaggerated, stylized 3D caricature portrait based on the person in the attached reference photo. Preserve the subject’s identity, facial likeness, skin tone, and defining features, but reinterpret them into a bold caricatured 3D form.
Apply strong, intentional deformation, including an elongated neck, an oversized head-to-neck ratio, droopy eyelids, heavy lips, and subtle facial asymmetry. The character should remain human-like while clearly stylized and expressive.
Use a clean, controlled surface finish with smooth, studio-quality skin. Avoid random textures, blemishes, freckles, dirt, grain, speckling, or noise. Materials should appear polished, premium, and carefully designed, with subtle subsurface scattering and realistic skin shading.
Dress the character in luxury fashion with bold, high-end accessories, creating a weird, fashion-forward, collectible aesthetic that feels character-driven rather than cute or realistic.
Illuminate the scene with neutral studio lighting, soft diffused shadows, and even illumination with no harsh contrast. Use a plain neutral gray or off-white background.
Render in ultra-high definition 4K quality with extreme detail, sharp focus, and cinematic clarity. Include micro-surface detail, high-resolution textures, physically based rendering (PBR), global illumination, soft reflections, and refined material definition. The image should appear crisp, clean, and noise-free, with professional studio render quality.
No text, logos, or watermarks.
Aspect ratio: 4:5.
